## Exploring penguin body measurements

This optional page adds another interactive view of the Palmer Penguins dataset. The scatterplot compares flipper length with body mass. Hover over a point to see the species, island, and measurements.

```{r}
#| label: explore-setup
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(glue)

penguins <- datasets::penguins |>
  drop_na(sex)
```

```{r}
#| label: flipper-mass-plot
#| warning: false

penguins_explore <- penguins |>
  mutate(
    label = glue(
      "{species} ({sex}) on {island} Island<br>",
      "Flipper length: {flipper_len} mm<br>",
      "Body mass: {body_mass} g"
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(
  penguins_explore,
  aes(
    x = flipper_len,
    y = body_mass,
    color = species,
    shape = species,
    text = label
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkorange", "purple", "cyan4")) +
  labs(
    x = "Flipper length (mm)",
    y = "Body mass (g)",
    color = "Species",
    shape = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_light()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```
